name: The Breakfast Klub
tagline: Houston's legendary breakfast institution famous for catfish and grits since 2001.
description: Houston's most beloved breakfast institution, The Breakfast Klub has been welcoming long lines of loyal regulars since 2001. Famous for catfish and grits, chicken and waffles, and an unwavering commitment to Southern breakfast perfection that has made it a Houston landmark.

name: Lucille's Houston
tagline: Nationally acclaimed Southern restaurant honoring great-grandmother Lucille B. Smith's culinary legacy.
description: Named for chef Chris Williams' great-great-grandmother Lucille B. Smith, this nationally acclaimed restaurant serves elevated Southern cuisine with deep historical roots. A Midtown Houston dining landmark celebrated for innovative takes on African American food traditions.

name: Burns Original BBQ
tagline: Houston BBQ institution serving slow-smoked Texas tradition since 1973.
description: A Houston BBQ institution since 1973, Burns Original has been smoking brisket, ribs, and sausage low and slow for generations of loyal customers. One of the city's most authentic and enduring pitmaster traditions, still going strong after 50 years.

name: Gatlin's BBQ
tagline: Houston craft BBQ pioneer bringing award-winning brisket and community love to Garden Oaks.
description: Greg Gatlin's Garden Oaks craft BBQ restaurant has earned a devoted following and national recognition for its carefully smoked brisket, ribs, and Southern sides. A hometown Houston success story built one perfect plate at a time.
address_line_1: 3510 Ella Blvd Bldg C Ste A

name: ChòpnBlọk
tagline: James Beard-nominated West African street food bringing jollof and jerk to Downtown Houston.
description: James Beard-nominated Nigerian-American chef Ope Amosu's Downtown Houston restaurant bringing West African street food — jollof rice, suya, and jerk chicken — to the heart of Texas. One of Houston's most celebrated and boldly original dining destinations.

name: Kulture Houston
tagline: Southern meets African-Caribbean fusion in Downtown Houston's vibrant arts district.
description: An upscale restaurant in Houston's arts district celebrating African-Caribbean and Southern culinary traditions with artfully prepared dishes and craft cocktails. Kulture has become a premier destination for Houston's culture-forward dining scene.
address_line_1: 701 Avenida De Las Americas Suite A

name: Triple J's Smokehouse
tagline: Trinity Gardens BBQ gem famous for boudin, loaded potatoes, and pure Texas soul.
description: A neighborhood gem in Trinity Gardens serving some of Houston's most beloved BBQ alongside loaded baked potatoes, boudin, and homestyle sides. Triple J's is the kind of place that becomes a family tradition passed from generation to generation.

name: Phil & Derek's
tagline: Cajun-Creole kitchen and jazz lounge serving soulful seafood and live music nightly.
description: A lively Cajun-Creole kitchen and jazz lounge in EaDo serving soulful seafood plates and live music nightly. Phil & Derek's captures the spirit of New Orleans right in Houston's vibrant Third Ward area.

name: Salon Meyerland
tagline: Houston's premier Black hair salon suite with 74 expert stylists under one roof.
description: One of Houston's largest and most established Black hair salon suites, with over 70 independent stylists under one roof serving all hair types and textures. A destination for anyone seeking expert natural hair care, extensions, color, or protective styles in Southwest Houston.

name: TRENDZ by Tammy
tagline: Natural and relaxed Black hair salon specializing in silk press, locs, and pixie cuts.
description: Houston's trusted natural and relaxed hair salon specializing in silk presses, locs, braids, and pixie cuts. Known for healthy hair practices and a welcoming atmosphere that keeps clients coming back for every appointment.

name: MELODRAMA Boutique
tagline: Third Ward women's fashion boutique mixing classic and contemporary threads since 2002.
description: A Third Ward Houston fashion institution since 2002, MELODRAMA offers curated women's clothing that blends classic elegance with contemporary edge. A beloved destination for style-forward shoppers who appreciate quality, individuality, and a boutique that knows the culture.

name: Yoga House Houston
tagline: Houston's first Black-owned yoga studio offering Kemetic and traditional yoga practices.
description: Houston's first Black-owned yoga studio, offering Kemetic yoga, traditional Hatha, and wellness workshops rooted in African traditions. A sanctuary on Cleburne Street where community, healing, and intentional movement come together.

name: TWT Fitness
tagline: Women-only fitness studio built on community, accountability, and real transformation.
description: A women-only fitness studio in the Houston area built entirely on community, accountability, and real transformation. TWT creates an encouraging environment where women of all fitness levels feel safe, supported, and motivated to reach their goals.

name: McConnell & Jones LLP
tagline: America's largest African American-owned CPA firm delivering audit, tax, and advisory services.
description: America's largest African American-owned CPA firm, providing audit, tax, and advisory services to corporations, nonprofits, and government entities since 1987. McConnell & Jones has earned national recognition for excellence in public accounting and a commitment to diverse leadership.

name: Jimerson Advisory Group
tagline: Black woman-owned CPA firm providing expert tax and financial guidance to Houston businesses.
description: A Black woman-owned CPA and financial advisory firm providing expert tax planning, business consulting, and financial guidance to Houston's entrepreneurs and small businesses. Trusted by clients who want a financial partner who truly understands their goals and their community.

name: Five Star Social Media Agency
tagline: Black-owned digital marketing agency growing Houston brands through bold social strategies.
description: A Houston-based Black-owned digital marketing agency helping businesses grow their brands through bold social media strategy, content creation, and community management. Known for delivering real, measurable growth for clients across multiple industries.

name: Houston Small Business Marketing
tagline: Black-owned agency helping Houston small businesses grow their digital presence and reach.
description: A full-service Black-owned marketing agency helping Houston small businesses build their digital presence through SEO, social media, and targeted advertising. Dedicated to making sophisticated marketing strategies accessible for businesses of every size.

name: The Ensemble Theatre
tagline: Houston's professional Black theatre company producing powerful African American stories since 1976.
description: Houston's only professional theater company dedicated to producing works by and about the African American experience, operating since 1976. The Ensemble has brought hundreds of productions to Houston stages, earning national recognition for artistic excellence and community service.

name: Blackacre Builders
tagline: Black-owned Houston homebuilder crafting quality custom homes in Independence Heights.
description: A Black-owned Houston homebuilder crafting quality custom homes with close attention to detail and deep community investment. Specializing in new construction in Independence Heights and surrounding Houston neighborhoods.

name: The Beauty Vault HTX
tagline: Houston's Black-owned beauty supply store stocking curated products for textured hair.
description: Houston's go-to Black-owned beauty supply store carrying a carefully curated selection of products for textured, natural, and protective styles. A one-stop shop stocking the products Black women in Houston actually need, without wading through products that weren't made for them.
